live_certificate_admission.name: stale_past_window
live_certificate_admission.reason: certificate is older than W_cert relative to the current authenticated origin — use the historical checkpoint/ancestry path

live_certificate_admission.name: future_ahead_of_origin
live_certificate_admission.reason: certificate round is ahead of the imported certified origin — retry after root progress

live_certificate_admission.name: signer_epoch_inactive
live_certificate_admission.reason: signer epoch was not active at the claimed root round

checkpoint_freshness_policy.note: Max checkpoint staleness = (Δ_hold - Δ_ev) real seconds - churn margin - acquisition latency, and strictly < the min real-time protection. The per-round floor must be >= ConsensusMinRoundPeriodSeconds (a protocol-enforced minimum, not a tuning knob); a policy below it is rejected. A deployment may raise MinRoundPeriodSeconds above the floor for slower observed pacing.

historical_block_authentication.name: wrong_trusted_head

proof_bundle_offline_verification.name: live_with_verifying_anchor

supply_and_backing.note: Vault native must cover O + C (the full bridge liability), not just O. WUCT is backed 1:1 by its own contract's native, separate from the vault.

redemption_relation.note: Direct (atomic, metered) and succinct (over-budget history) bind the same network/config/trust-base/nullifier/lock-refs/release-leaves.
